findings.current: The nomads kept fighting, not daring to interfere in the battle of their superior, who was practically a tyrant. The Shanxi defenders, gradually tiring against the endless waves of enemy troops.
findings.defect: The nomads are said to keep fighting immediately after the narration says everyone stopped moving; the second sentence is also a fragment.
findings.rationale: Preserves what each side had been doing while making the battlefield-wide pause coherent.
findings.replacement: Even the nomads, who had kept fighting rather than interfere in their tyrannical superior’s battle, stopped. So did the Shanxi defenders, worn down by the endless waves of enemy troops.
findings.source: Chapter 962, pause after the Demon Bird is struck

findings.current: The death of the one stringing a bow on his composite bow became the signal.
findings.defect: “Stringing a bow on his composite bow” is an unnatural and confusing description of the action.
findings.rationale: Corrects the English without changing the stated action from stringing the bow to drawing or firing it.
findings.replacement: The death of the man stringing his composite bow became the signal.
findings.source: Chapter 963, archer killed during Mukyung’s stand

summary: The packet is broadly consistent. Two local prose issues are actionable; the summaries and active state preserve the unresolved approaching force.
